service.tsl.association_index_tsl_source: Association of TSL index → source (shm) for this connection. When a TSL packet arrives with that index, the designated label column of the matching source is updated.
service.tsl.chaque_connexion_ouvre_un_se: Each connection opens a TCP server on its own port. The TSL text field received automatically updates the designated label column. This connection's LH/RH/TT tally levels are mapped onto the global levels starting from Tally base.
service.tsl.gestion_avancee_des_sources_: Advanced source management: column sorting, filters, multi-cell selection and auto-increment (spreadsheet style). The TSL index → source mapping is now edited there directly: one index column per connection (fill-down/auto-increment to number them in bulk). The “Mapping” panel below remains a per-connection view.
service.tsl.tous_les_tallies_actuellemen: All currently active tallies, grouped by connection (= Tally level). IDX = the TSL index sent by the controller (the source number). Red and Green are the fields defined per connection (the “Red / Green” column above); the associated source (if mapped) is shown next to the index.
